name: Opportune Spellstrike
body:
Your quick reflexes and skill at spellcasting allows you to take advantage of an opening with a quickly cast spell.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells, Combat reflexes, BAB +12, Quicken Spell or Quickened Magic arcana.

Benefit(s): You may cast a touch spell as an attack of opportunity. If you have the spellstrike class feature, you may deliver this attack with a melee weapon.
